title: control 6 — source-digest freshness (freshness receipt field + fail-closed on STALE/UNKNOWN)
objective: Implement the long-deferred acceptance control 6 now that deep-research owns acquisition: add a source-receipt freshness field (CURRENT/STALE/UNKNOWN) plus an optional resolved_revision, and enforce that a claim may not rest on a STALE or UNKNOWN source (fail closed). deep-research sets freshness on re-resolution; the gate reads the receipt (it does not fetch). Migrate the three examples with recomputed evidence_digests. badf-research stays DESIGNED (5 of 9 P0).
business_value: Freshness is the difference between 'a URL still exists' and 'the evidence is current'. A claim resting on a source whose bytes changed, or that can no longer be resolved, is no longer supported; failing closed on stale/unknown sources stops a decision from being built on evidence that has moved.
in_scope: schemas/research-record.schema.json: source freshness (CURRENT/STALE/UNKNOWN, required) + optional resolved_revision
